modules.title: Algebra Foundations
modules.description: Master the building blocks of algebra: evaluating expressions, order of operations, and substituting values into algebraic expressions.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team

modules.title: Cryptography Basics
modules.description: An introduction to the fundamentals of cryptography, covering classical ciphers, cryptographic protocols, and modern cryptographic concepts.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team

modules.title: The Fall of Rome
modules.description: An exploration of the factors that led to the decline and eventual fall of the Western Roman Empire, examining political, economic, military, and social causes.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team

modules.title: Graphing & Linear Relationships
modules.description: Learn to plot linear equations on the coordinate plane, understand slope and intercepts, and interpret graphs as real-world models.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team

modules.title: Inequalities & Systems
modules.description: Solve and graph linear inequalities, represent solution sets on a number line, and analyze systems of linear equations using substitution and elimination.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team

modules.title: Linear Equations
modules.description: Solve one-step, two-step, and multi-step linear equations. Learn to isolate variables, check solutions, and translate word problems into algebraic form.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team

modules.title: Introduction to Logic
modules.description: A foundational module covering deductive and inductive reasoning, common fallacies, argument analysis, and real-world applications of logic. Includes interactive exercises and assessments.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team

modules.title: The Scientific Revolution
modules.description: An exploration of the scientific revolution of the 16th and 17th centuries, examining the key figures, discoveries, and paradigm shifts that transformed our understanding of the natural world.
modules.author: Modular Learning Team
